title: Login with valid credentials
description: Verifies that a registered user can successfully log in using a valid email and password combination.
steps: Navigate to login page. Enter valid email and password. Click Login button.
expected_result: User is redirected to dashboard. Session token is created. Last login timestamp updated.

title: Login with invalid password
description: Verifies that login fails gracefully when an incorrect password is provided.
steps: Navigate to login page. Enter valid email and wrong password. Click Login button.
expected_result: Error message displayed. No session created. Failed attempt counter incremented.

title: Account lockout after repeated failed logins
description: Verifies account is locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts to prevent brute force attacks.
steps: Attempt login with wrong password 5 times consecutively.
expected_result: Account locked after 5th attempt. Lockout email sent. Login disabled for 30 minutes.

title: Password reset via email
description: Verifies user can reset their password through the email-based reset flow.
steps: Click Forgot Password. Enter registered email. Click reset link in email. Enter and confirm new password.
expected_result: Password updated successfully. All existing sessions invalidated. Confirmation email sent.

title: OAuth login with Google
description: Verifies that users can authenticate using their Google account via OAuth 2.0.
steps: Click Login with Google. Complete Google OAuth flow. Return to application.
expected_result: User authenticated. Profile populated from Google. Session created with OAuth token.

title: Session expiry after inactivity
description: Verifies that user sessions expire correctly after the configured inactivity timeout period.
steps: Login successfully. Remain inactive for session timeout period. Attempt any authenticated action.
expected_result: Session invalidated. User redirected to login page. Appropriate session expired message shown.

title: Add item to cart
description: Verifies that a user can add a product to their shopping cart and the cart reflects the correct item and quantity.
steps: Browse to a product page. Select quantity. Click Add to Cart.
expected_result: Item appears in cart. Cart item count badge updated. Cart total reflects item price.

title: Remove item from cart
description: Verifies that a user can remove an item from their cart and totals update correctly.
steps: Add item to cart. Navigate to cart. Click Remove on item.
expected_result: Item removed from cart. Cart total recalculated. Empty cart message shown if last item.

title: Apply valid promo code at checkout
description: Verifies that entering a valid promotional code at checkout correctly reduces the order subtotal by the specified discount percentage before tax calculation.
steps: Add items to cart. Proceed to checkout. Enter promo code SAVE10. Click Apply.
expected_result: 10% discount applied to subtotal. Promo code label shown. Savings amount displayed. Total recalculated.

title: Apply expired promo code
description: Verifies that an expired promotional code is rejected with an appropriate error message.
steps: Proceed to checkout. Enter expired promo code. Click Apply.
expected_result: Error message shown: Promo code has expired. No discount applied. Total unchanged.

title: Bulk order discount tier validation
description: Verifies that bulk order discount tiers are correctly applied when order quantity meets the threshold.
steps: Add 50 units of a product. Proceed to checkout. Review order summary.
expected_result: Bulk discount tier 2 applied (15% off). Discount clearly labelled. Unit price updated.

title: Checkout with saved payment method
description: Verifies that a user can complete checkout using a previously saved payment method.
steps: Add items to cart. Proceed to checkout. Select saved Visa ending 4242. Place order.
expected_result: Payment processed successfully. Order confirmed. Confirmation email triggered.

title: Payment with new credit card
description: Verifies end-to-end payment flow with a new credit card including tokenisation and charge.
steps: Proceed to checkout. Enter new card details. Click Pay Now.
expected_result: Card tokenised. Payment authorised. Order created. Receipt emailed to user.

title: Payment declined - insufficient funds
description: Verifies correct handling when a payment is declined due to insufficient funds.
steps: Proceed to checkout. Enter card with insufficient funds. Click Pay Now.
expected_result: Payment declined error displayed. Order not created. User prompted to use different payment method.

title: International card payment
description: Verifies that cards issued outside the home country are accepted and currency conversion applied correctly.
steps: Proceed to checkout. Enter non-domestic card. Complete payment.
expected_result: Payment accepted. Currency converted at current rate. Conversion fee applied if applicable.

title: Refund for cancelled order
description: Verifies that cancelling an order within the cancellation window triggers a full refund to the original payment method.
steps: Place order. Navigate to order history. Click Cancel Order within 1 hour.
expected_result: Order cancelled. Refund initiated. Refund confirmation email sent. Refund appears in payment history.

title: Product search by keyword
description: Verifies that searching by keyword returns relevant products ranked by relevance score.
steps: Enter keyword in search bar. Press Enter.
expected_result: Relevant products displayed. Results sorted by relevance. Search term highlighted in results.

title: Filter products by category
description: Verifies that applying a category filter correctly narrows search results to the selected category.
steps: Perform a search. Apply category filter. Review results.
expected_result: Only products in selected category shown. Filter chip displayed. Result count updated.

title: Out of stock product display
description: Verifies that out of stock products are correctly flagged and the Add to Cart button is disabled.
steps: Navigate to a product with 0 stock.
expected_result: Out of Stock badge displayed. Add to Cart button disabled. Notify Me option visible.

title: Stock level update after purchase
description: Verifies that inventory stock levels are decremented correctly after a successful order is placed.
steps: Note current stock level. Complete purchase of N units. Check stock level.
expected_result: Stock level reduced by N. If stock reaches 0, product marked as out of stock.

title: Order confirmation email sent
description: Verifies that an order confirmation email is sent to the customer immediately after order placement.
steps: Complete a purchase. Check email inbox.
expected_result: Confirmation email received within 2 minutes. Contains order ID, item list, total, and delivery estimate.

title: Shipping update notification
description: Verifies that a shipping notification is sent when order status changes to Shipped.
steps: Place order. Admin marks order as shipped. Check customer email.
expected_result: Shipping notification email received. Tracking number included. Estimated delivery date shown.

title: Password reset email deliverability
description: Verifies that password reset emails are delivered reliably and the reset link is valid.
steps: Request password reset. Check email. Click reset link.
expected_result: Email delivered within 60 seconds. Reset link valid for 24 hours. Single-use only.

title: Price rule: percentage discount
description: Verifies that percentage-based discount price rules are calculated correctly on the final order total.
steps: Create order with items totalling $100. Apply 20% discount rule.
expected_result: Discount of $20 applied. Final total $80 before tax. Rule audit log entry created.

title: Price rule: fixed amount discount
description: Verifies that fixed-amount discount rules deduct the correct dollar amount from the order total.
steps: Create order over minimum spend threshold. Apply fixed $15 discount rule.
expected_result: Exactly $15 deducted from total. Rule not applied if order below minimum spend.

title: Price rule: buy X get Y free
description: Verifies that buy-X-get-Y-free promotional pricing rules are applied correctly in the cart.
steps: Add 3 qualifying items to cart. Proceed to checkout.
expected_result: Cheapest qualifying item priced at $0. Rule label shown in cart. Total reflects free item.

title: Stacked discount rules conflict resolution
description: Verifies that when multiple discount rules apply, the system correctly resolves conflicts based on priority order.
steps: Apply two conflicting discount rules to same order.
expected_result: Higher priority rule applied. Lower priority rule skipped. Conflict logged.

title: Order creation with multiple line items
description: Verifies that an order with multiple distinct products and quantities is created correctly with accurate line item totals.
steps: Add 3 different products with different quantities. Complete checkout.
expected_result: Order created with all line items. Per-item and total pricing accurate. Order ID generated.

title: Order status transitions
description: Verifies that orders transition through valid states: Pending > Confirmed > Processing > Shipped > Delivered.
steps: Place order. Trigger each status transition via admin panel.
expected_result: Each transition succeeds. Invalid transitions blocked. Timestamps recorded per transition.

title: Guest checkout without account
description: Verifies that a user without an account can complete a purchase as a guest.
steps: Add items to cart. Proceed to checkout. Select Guest Checkout. Enter email and payment.
expected_result: Order placed successfully. Confirmation sent to guest email. No account created.
